milestone: MSCA-DN historical validation, ticket V02d (Dispose of the missing calibration and regression datasets) in plans/msca_dn_historical_validation_tickets.md; closes part of finding F08 of plans/reports/MSCA_DN_Readiness_Audit_2026-10-08.md
authority: CLAUDE.md §9.4 (a decision that affects future interpretation is written to Tier 4), §12.1 (an output names its inputs and flags its assumptions), §12.2 (the four status categories), §12.4 (a missing mandatory input triggers a declared failure, never hallucinated completion), §15 (a declared gap over a fabricated completion). Ticket V02d. Not a constitutional amendment.
decision: Every check that reads an absent substrate is recorded as EXCLUDED, not restored. The two harness dataset directories are the subject the ticket names; the review of this work added the absent Tier 3 confirmation checklist and the unfrozen E5f report, so the document now accounts for every skip the focused command reports rather than only the dataset ones. The exclusions are enumerated in harness/DATASET_DISPOSITIONS.md with a dataset, a reason, replacement evidence where any exists, and the work that lifts them. The two affected test modules now skip with a reason that names the dataset and that document; before this record they failed and errored, which read as product defects. tests/harness/test_dataset_dispositions.py keeps the enumeration honest in both directions: an exclusion missing from the table fails, and a row naming a module that does not exist fails. harness/HARNESS.md and both dataset READMEs point at the document, so a reader of harness status cannot reach a green lane without meeting the absence.
why: The datasets are absent, and the audit is explicit that missing gold data must stay visible and must not become a claim of successful calibration. A failing check and an excluded check carry different meanings to a reader of release confidence: the first says the code is broken, the second says the evidence does not exist. Eight checks were reporting the first while meaning the second.

gold_sets.basis: harness/gold_sets/ holds its README only; the seeded template its README describes is not in the tree
gold_sets.reason: A gold set is human ground truth. harness/gold_sets/README.md states the rule this repository adopted: an AI labelling a gold set for an AI judge reintroduces the grader-generator correlation the harness exists to detect. An agent cannot produce this dataset.
gold_sets.lifted_by: ticket X03 (Human DN calibration and gold datasets), which closes finding F10

regression_baselines.basis: harness/regression_baselines/ holds its README only; measured on this checkout at 621ec1a
regression_baselines.reason: A refreeze is technically available and deterministic, but the E4 lane is merge-advisory and human-decided by its own documented contract: the human either refreezes or investigates. Choosing to refreeze is that human decision, and V02d's constraint against an agent-authored draft impersonating operator approval covers it. A refreeze would also replace the drafter-era side of the LG-1 granularity measurement with the graph-sourced side, which the measurement suite's own docstring names as work that must be budgeted with it.
regression_baselines.lifted_by: an operator refreeze (py -3.10 -m harness.regression freeze) plus re-pointing tests/harness/test_measure_ledger_granularity.py; ticket X03 covers the maintained-dataset half
